english: Babies of two months old do not appear to be reluctant to enter the water.
text: do not appear to be reluctant 只说从表现看没有不愿下水，未直接断言婴儿内心很喜欢。描述观察可用 appear 或 seem 标明判断来自外在迹象；删去它们改成 are not reluctant，判断就更直接。
author: doubao-seed-2-1-turbo-260628
